text: file_path Path Excel input file (.xlsx .xls). method Vector methods compute: "internal", "external", "restricted", "restricted_prod", "restricted_subj", "restricted_both", "prefmax". sheet_liking Name sheet containing consumer liking data (required). sheet_products Name sheet containing product variables. sheet_subjects Name sheet containing consumer variables. ndim Starting dimension analysis (default: 2). max_dim Maximum dimension analysis. specified, iterates ndim max_dim. clustering Logical. Performs consumer clustering TRUE (default: TRUE). n_clusters Numeric. Forced number clusters. max_k Maximum number clusters tested Silhouette search (default: 6). scale.unit Logical. Standardizes product variables PrefMaX TRUE (default: FALSE). scale_desc Scale factor product variable vectors biplots (default: 1). scale_subj Scale factor consumer background variables biplots (default: 1). min_r2 Minimum R2 threshold display product variables biplots (default: 1.0). ridge_x Ridge regularization parameter product constraints Unfolding (default: 1e-3). ridge_y Ridge regularization parameter subject constraints Unfolding (default: 1e-3). type_unfold Unfolding transformation type smacofRect (default: "ordinal"). conditionality Matrix conditionality smacofRect (default: "row"). method_diss Dissimilarity conversion method sim2diss (default: "reverse"). itmax Maximum number iterations smacofRect algorithm (default: 10000). label_consumers Logical. Displays individual consumer labels biplots TRUE (default: FALSE). plot3D Logical. Generates interactive 3D plot Unfolding TRUE (default: FALSE). short_id Short identifier string exported file naming. out_dir Output directory path. NULL, uses input file directory. save_tiff Logical. Exports biplot figures TIFF images TRUE (default: TRUE). dpi Image resolution DPI saved TIFF files (default: 300). sheet_hedo Legacy alias sheet_liking. sheet_qda Legacy alias sheet_products. ... Additional optional arguments.
